messages:
Marin: Quick thread to close the Apr 22 postmortem loop for customer comms. Deliverables: short statuspage blurb, 72h public summary, enterprise outreach templates, and a concise RCA-access sentence. Also assign SRE owner for the recurring KV-cache eviction pattern and get owners + deadlines into the action tracker.

Zoe: I'm around. Is there a draft link to start from?

Marin: See draft folder: https://docs.redwood.example/incidents/apr-22-2024/comms-drafts. Main constraints: keep public copy non-technical, offer enterprise briefings proactively, and include how customers request a detailed RCA.

Derek: Ill take the statuspage blurb. Two lines max. Proposing to avoid words like "root cause" and use "investigation identified" instead.

Priya: I'll own the 72h public summary (public-facing). Need until 2024-04-26 17:00 PT to loop Legal and redact where needed. I'll include a short "recurrence note" about KV cache evictions.

Liam: Enterprise outreach and briefing templates I can do. Will prepare CS scripts and offer 1:1 briefings for materially impacted accounts. ETA 2024-04-26 COB.

Derek: Proposed statuspage copy (please react with edits):
```
Status: Partial service disruption  Resolved
Summary: Between 03:12 and 03:42 UTC some requests to the embeddings endpoint experienced higher latency and errors for a subset of requests. We mitigated the impact and service is operating normally. A public summary will be posted within 72 hours.
```

LegalBot: Suggest swapping "errors" -> "errors for some requests" and changing "public summary" -> "redacted public summary" to manage expectations. Also avoid internal incident IDs in public text.

Derek: Updated per LegalBot. Also add line about how to request more detail via Support. Draft now: 
```
Summary: Between 03:12 and 03:42 UTC some requests to the embeddings endpoint experienced higher latency and errors for some requests. We mitigated the impact and service is operating normally. A redacted public summary will be posted within 72 hours. Impacted customers may request a detailed RCA via Support.
```

Priya: That looks good. For the 72h public summary I'll cover: timeline, impact buckets (no PII), mitigation steps, immediate mitigations for recurrence, and "how to request RCA". ETA 2024-04-26 17:00 PT.

Marin: For RCA sharing policy, propose a single sentence: "A redacted public summary is available; customers who experienced material impact may request a detailed RCA via Support. Sensitive information may be shared under NDA at Legal's discretion." Who can draft the exact one-liner for statuspage?

Liam: I'll draft the enterprise-facing paragraph and the support request flow (email templates + briefing offer). Will reference the Support contact flow rather than exposing any internal IDs.

Mateo: I'll take ownership of the recurring KV cache eviction follow-up and open a tracking task for mitigations and monitoring. ETA mitigation proposal 2024-05-06.

incident-bot: Ticket INC-8230 created and assigned to Liam (enterprise outreach). Link: https://tracker.redwood.example/INC-8230

incident-bot: Action ITEM-8231 created and assigned to Mateo (Platform SRE): investigate recurring KV cache evictions and propose mitigations by 2024-05-06. Link: https://tracker.redwood.example/ITEM-8231

LegalBot: I'll review the RCA blurb and expected templates. Quick note: if customers request logs or sensitive traces, Legal wants a redaction checklist and an NDA template ready. I can have feedback by 2024-04-28.

Priya: I'll flag any redaction candidates in the 72h draft and call out where we need the NDA template.

Marin: Action list to add to the incident tracker:
- Statuspage copy: Derek -> push to staging 2024-04-25 17:30 PT, publish 2024-04-25 18:00 PT
- 72h public summary: Priya -> 2024-04-26 17:00 PT
- Enterprise outreach & templates: Liam -> 2024-04-26 COB
- RCA policy blurb & legal signoff: LegalBot -> signoff by 2024-04-28
- Recurrence mitigation plan and monitoring updates: Mateo/Platform SRE -> proposal 2024-05-06

Zoe: I'll add these to the postmortem action tracker and assign reminders. Quick sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to sign off on wording. :calendar:

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled for 1850003600 (tomorrow 10:30 PT).
